name: seventask-calculator-stc
description: SevenTask Calculator by Kawkab Tech Labs: 136 everyday, finance, business, science and conversion calculators with an interactive result card.

interface.longDescription: The official SevenTask Calculator by Kawkab Tech Labs. Instantly calculate percentages, discounts, EMI, SIP, GST, averages, age, BMI, shop profits, fuel costs, unit conversions and more. Browse daily-use, basic maths, finance, business and home collections or search all 136 calculators. ChatGPT-supported views display a premium compact results card with Edit Inputs and Recalculate. Calculations involving finance, tax or health are estimates, not professional advice.
defaultPrompt: Calculate EMI for a ₹3 lakh loan at 8% for 3 years.

publication.release_notes: New STC plugin entry with a premium 1024px calculator-only icon, official .in MCP domain, 136 calculators, 14 tools, and an interactive Edit/Recalculate result card where supported by the ChatGPT host.
